text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is an original research article focused on conservation assessment incorporating climate change scenarios and vegetation productivity variability in Canada’s boreal forest. Instead, it uses vegetation productivity variability probabilities derived from climate and remote sensing data for conservation prioritization. The study’s primary focus is on conservation planning under climate change uncertainty, not on explicit spatial LULC prediction or simulation at the national scale.)
